what: The batch item detail draws a kept raster or point cloud that its display reads say is not placed (no batch area, outside the area, no stated CRS) in the file's own frame: raster parts as one canvas mosaic laid out by their sourceCorners, point parts as a top-down scatter. Words: the not-placed reason as the route states it and 'Display only, not on the map.' No new route; nothing is placed, converted or measured.

reuse.routes: parts page, part display read, raster-window and point-batch artifact routes through browserSurfaceIo (bytes checked against the display read's size and SHA-256)
reuse.decode: SurfaceDecoder worker (decodePart): TIFF to picture, LAS records placed between the part's sourceCorners, so points stay in source coordinates
reuse.gate: isSurfaceItem and item placement other than on_map; the section appears only once a display read answers not_placed

bounds: Display reads in part order, at most 256 per file and 4 in flight (SURFACE_LIMITS, the map's own); a placed part is counted, its artifact never read
frame: One scale on both axes, fitted to 640 x 400 canvas pixels; the first part's first corner (window upper left, batch north-west) is drawn at the top, so no axis is assumed from a CRS

cases: raster no_batch_area: 2 parts drawn by drawImage at setTransform [160,0,0,160,0,0] and [160,0,0,160,320,0] with 'Not placed: 2 parts: Read but not placed: the batch has no map area yet.' and the display-only words
point batch no_stated_crs: 3 native LAS format 1 records decoded by decodePart land at canvas pixels (0,318), (638,159), (319,0); 12 pixels painted
placed display read: no section, no artifact read; opensPreview false for on_map and for a table
300 published parts: 256 display reads, at most 4 in flight, cap named in words
check.contract: every display body in the test is checked against docs/api/openapi.json

realLook.how: Throwaway local harness (kept outside Git under E:/ulpin-tmp/s5-12/harness) served from this worktree on port 5212; MSW answered the four existing routes with bodies made by the repository's own readers (raster_window._read_native, point_batch._read_native_batch) from the kept originals; the real decode worker drew them. No demo or rehearsal runtime, no sign-in.
